notes.title: Bumping into full release soon
notes.content:
Its been a while since we made bump bump bump available in early access. In this couple of months we have been working on adjusting the game for it to be able to handle user created levels. This is the last thing we needed to make in order to feel comfortable saying the game is 'done'.

The last thing we need to make is some easy to use tool so that anyone can make and edit new levels. If you are one of those interested in making levels and will be using the editor, we would like to hear from you what sort of things you like to have in said editor. Please post your suggestions, what you expect of a level editor for our game, what things you [b] don't [/b] like to see in it, and all the feedback you have for us. Once we have a clear idea of what the editor needs to be, we will release it in an update following the release, as well as the whole workshop integration we've been working on.

Its very important for us to hear from people who will be using the editor, and will be making levels. Without your input we might have to scratch the whole idea. After all, there is no point in making the modding tools if no one is going to use them. So please, make a post in the community hub or send us an email to contact@goldenfrogstudio.com if you are interested, we will be reading whatever you send to us.

With the game being able to support new levels made by the community, we will proceed to exit early access and release Bump bump bump in the following days.

Thanks for playing, and we hope you enjoy the game if you haven't.

notes.title: Bump Bump Bump available now on Early Acces
notes.content:
We just released Bump Bump Bump in early access, and we are looking at the following months to finish adding content for the final release. We hope to hear from you how you like the game in its current state, and we hope we can have good meaningful discussions about this in the following weeks.

We hope you enjoy the game and get to see it trough, with us, to its final release.
